test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As on July 2022, how many Fundamental Duties are there in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are **11 fundamental obligations**, including:

 
 
• Respect the **Constitution, the flag, and the National Anthem.**
 
• Embrace the **principles of the freedom struggle.**
 
• Safeguard **India's integrity and sovereignty.**
 
• When required, defend the nation and perform **civic duties.**
 
• Spirit of a group of brothers.
 
• Conserve a diverse culture.
 
• Keep the surroundings natural.
 
• Embrace a scientific mindset.
 
• Keep public property safe.
 
• **Aim for superiority.**
 
• All parents and guardians have a responsibility to enroll their children in school between the **ages of 6 and 14.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Fundamental Duties of India** are connected to the **Swaran Singh Committee**.
 
• The **Swaran Singh Committee's** recommendations led to the addition of **11 Fundamental Duties to the Indian Constitution.**
 
• The Fundamental Duties are covered by **Article 51A** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976 **added the Fundamental Duties to the Indian Constitution.
 
• The **USSR** provided the idea for the Indian constitution's essential obligations (Union of Soviet Socialist Republics).
